summary: A passage from a fiction book (Book 4, part 29) in which Liza the Organiza, self-described as the Lizanator and El Presidente of the Clan Fahrenheit, addresses a room of schoolgirls about gaming. She boasts of her world-champion record and kill count, urges the girls to play as female characters, and offers probationary Clan Fahrenheit memberships to those who do. Anda, a listener who has never met a Fahrenheit in person, jumps to her feet at the end of the excerpt.
one_line: Liza the Organiza, the Lizanator, recruits schoolgirls to play female gaming characters and join the Clan Fahrenheit.
key_facts: Liza the Organiza calls herself the Lizanator, Queen of the Spacelanes, and El Presidente of the Clan Fahrenheit.
The Clan Fahrenheit had chapters in every game and had their own island in Anda's game.
Liza says she won the Clan Fahrenheit title through popular election, but members voted her in because of her prowess in combat.
Liza claims to be a world-champion in six different games, from first-person shooters to strategy games.
Liza states that her battle record is 3,522 kills in a single battle.
Liza says she has taken home cash prizes from competitions totaling more than 400,000 pounds.
Liza says she games for four to six hours nearly every day.
Liza tells the girls that girls are faster, smarter and better than boys, and that they play harder.
Liza says she started playing at 10, when there were no women in games and you could not even buy a game in some shops.
Liza asks how many girls game, and about half the room raises a hand; when she asks how many play as girls, all the hands go down.
Liza offers probationary memberships in the Clan Fahrenheit to girls who will play as a girl, with full membership after six months if they measure up.
Liza describes the gamespace as smelling like a boy's armpit and says it is time to 'girl it up a little.'
In real life, Liza wears a black jumper over loose dungarees and steel-toed goth boots, which Anda suspects came from a goth shop in Camden Town.
Anda is described as a little podgy, like Liza, and Anda jumps to her feet at the end of the excerpt, when Liza asks who wants to be a girl out-game and in.
